definition: Replacing a number with a simpler value close to it, such as to the nearest $1000$, to a number of decimal places or to a number of significant figures.
A digit position after the decimal point, so $5.384$ has three decimal places.
A digit of a number counted from its first non-zero digit (zeros that only fill places at the end of a whole number don't count), so $0.0507$ has three significant figures: $5$, $0$ and $7$.
A rough answer to a calculation, found by rounding each number (usually to $1$ significant figure) and working it out with the rounded values.
